title: Bond order as retained joining multiplicity
statement: Bond order is the exact positive rational degree of complete joining-channel support for one identified bond relative to one localized electron-pair joining unit, with the observation partition retained.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered bond-order carrier, support, reference, quantity, delocalization, method, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite identified bond with complete joining-channel support, measured relative to one localized electron-pair joining unit using exact positive counts or rational support parts.

choices.name: index-without-bond
choices.reason: A number detached from a bond has no meaning.

choices.name: identified-bond-carrier
choices.reason: The index remains bound to one joining support.

choices.name: selected-channel-count
choices.reason: Omitting channels can force the degree.

choices.name: complete-joining-channel-support
choices.reason: Every registered bonding channel is included.

choices.name: arbitrary-scale
choices.reason: A free scale can select any order.

choices.name: single-localized-pair-reference
choices.reason: One localized pair supplies the admitted comparison unit.

choices.name: floating-index
choices.reason: Floating arithmetic cannot certify the exact support ratio.

choices.name: integer-only-order
choices.reason: Delocalized support can distribute a joining unit across links.

choices.name: rational-support-sharing-retained
choices.reason: Exact parts preserve fractional link support without irrational values.

choices.name: one-partition-as-absolute
choices.reason: Different observational partitions can report different indices.

choices.name: partition-bound-index
choices.reason: The measurement/partition method remains part of the record.

choices.name: order-answer-only
choices.reason: An index alone cannot reproduce support.

choices.name: bond-channel-reference-trace
choices.reason: Bond, channels, reference and partition remain held.

choices.name: free-order-correction
choices.reason: A correction can force a conventional integer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Complete support/reference ratio determines the index.

induction_base: One localized electron-pair joining channel supplies the One reference bond order.
induction_step: Appending or exactly sharing one generated channel updates the positive rational support/reference degree while retaining every prior channel and partition record.
exclusions: no IUPAC bond definition, orbital equation, electronegativity scale, measured value or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application result or opaque predictor
no universal bond-length/strength formula inferred from a categorical correspondence
official target content opens only through post-seal custody
Every finite identified bond with complete joining-channel support, measured relative to one localized electron-pair joining unit using exact positive counts or rational support parts.
operational_witnesses: one localized channel has exact One degree
two retained channels have positive counted multiplicity
falsification_condition: The claim fails if IUPAC lacks a bonding-degree index, single-bond reference or localized electron-pair reference, or if a changed row is accepted.
